description: Capability for the viewer window (SPEC-0300-0015 R-432/R-432-4; SPEC-0200-0001 §3.5.2/§3.5.12.5): only the four viewer-only commands plus the minimal core permissions the viewer route needs (listening for the pending-open-changed event, and closing itself on Esc/Ctrl+Q). No `core:default`, no `opener:*` permission (R-405-1) — the backend calls tauri-plugin-opener's free function directly, without registering the plugin.
